chunks: Sufficient for the believer as help from Allah is that he sees his enemy acting in disobedience to Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer; the one characterized by faith
key_terms.بِمَعَاصِي اللَّهِ: through acts of disobedience against Allah
key_terms.عَدُوَّهُ: his enemy; the one opposed to him
key_terms.نُصْرَةً: help, support, or victory granted by Allah

ai.seo_question: How is seeing an enemy commit sins considered help from Allah for a believer?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (عليه السلام) teaches that one form of divine support for the believer is seeing his enemy fall into disobedience against Allah. The hadith frames sin itself as a mark of loss and disgrace, showing that true victory is tied to obedience to Allah, not merely worldly advantage.
